content: Lactic acid, citric acid, and potassium bitartrate are indicated for use as an on-demand contraceptive method to prevent pregnancy in females of reproductive potential. A single prefilled applicator containing 5 grams of the product should be applied vaginally either immediately before or up to one hour prior to each act of vaginal intercourse. If more than one act of vaginal intercourse occurs within one hour, an additional dose must be applied. Each 5-gram dose contains 90 mg of lactic acid, 50 mg of citric acid, and 20 mg of potassium bitartrate. The safety and efficacy of this product have not been fully established. However, it is expected to have similar efficacy in postmenarchal females under the age of 17 as in those aged 17 and older. This product is not indicated for use before menarche. If hypersensitivity reactions occur, the product should be discontinued immediately. It should not be used during pregnancy, and its use should be discontinued if pregnancy occurs. There is no available data on the use of this product in pregnant females or animals. Additionally, there is no information on the presence of lactic acid, citric acid, potassium bitartrate, or their metabolites in human milk, nor their effects on breastfeeding or milk production. The introduction of semen into the vagina increases the vaginal pH to above 6 due to the alkalinity of ejaculate, which neutralizes the normally acidic vaginal environment and allows spermatozoa to survive. The vaginal pH-lowering effect of lactic acid, citric acid, and potassium bitartrate reduces sperm motility and contributes to the contraceptive activity within the vagina. Pharmacokinetic studies in humans have not been conducted. However, systemic exposure to lactic acid, citric acid, and potassium bitartrate following vaginal administration is not expected to raise safety concerns. This product may be used during any part of the menstrual cycle and can be used as soon as it is safe to resume vaginal intercourse after childbirth, abortion, or miscarriage. The product should be stored in its original foil packaging at room temperature, between 20–25°C (68–77°F), with permissible excursions to 15–30°C (59–86°F).
